# Check task

Verify a change end-to-end in the real UI.

## Run modes
- Developer (inside the repository).
- PM (no code access).

## Running the check
1. Open the right environment.
2. Walk through the scenario.
3. Capture screenshots.

## Report
Summarize what was checked and the result.
